description: Use this in a contest with blind rounds whose board shows the last round (get_competition's blindRounds.board is last_round) to see every entry's rank and score as the latest judged round ranked them. NOT live: the same for everyone, frozen until the next round is judged; live ranks and scores stay hidden until the results are published. An admin reads the rows whatever board says (admin_only true when only an admin would), and so does the bounty's own sponsor, the account that posted it (sponsor_only true when only the sponsor would); either may pass round (1-based on the current schedule) to read any judged round's whole board, not only the latest (round_pick true; anyone else passing it is refused); with the board hidden any other signed-in entrant reads the five entries above and below their own place instead (around_you true, the page ignored). Answers board (hidden or last_round), admin_only, sponsor_only, round_pick, around_you, blind_rounds (the schedule, as get_my_rounds has it), score (the score column: title, precision, which way is better), round (round, of, cutoff_at: it ranked the entries received by then, judged_at, field; null while the board is hidden, before the first round is judged and once the results are out), entries (one page, best first: rank, score, submission_id, title, handle, image, house, you: yours; a house or internal entry and one not accepted are left out, keeping the others' ranks), total, offset and limit. Page with offset and limit (1 to 200, default 50). A competition you may not see is its 404.

round.description: An admin or the bounty's own sponsor alone: the judged interim round to read, 1-based on the current schedule (default the latest judged)

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

name: get_round_board

admin_only.description: True when the rows show only because the caller is an admin (board hidden to everyone else)

around_you.description: True when, with the board hidden, entries is your own window: the five listed entries above and below your best-placed entry, offset its place

blind_rounds.description: The round schedule (as get_my_rounds answers it); null when blind rounds are off

board.description: hidden: no one's rank or score shows until the results publish; last_round: this board shows

entries.description: One page of that round's entries, best first, each with its stored rank (ranks may skip a left-out entry)

cutoff_at.description: It ranked the entries received by then (ISO 8601)

round.description: The judged round shown (the latest on the current schedule, or the one round asked for); null while the board is hidden or shows none

round_pick.description: True when the caller (an admin or the sponsor) may pass round to read any judged round

score.description: How a score reads; null with no bundle

sponsor_only.description: True when the rows show only because the caller posted this bounty (its sponsor; board hidden to everyone else)

title: Get the previous blind round's board (not live)
